items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: I remember, I think it was Mrs. Phillips, you know, Babe Phillips, his wife, was going to go to that dance I believe that night.

ctx.x: That's part of his picture there. They didn't do it. Two other, couldn't find the rest of it. Yeah. Sorry I destroyed that picture like that. That's part of his picture, Walter Bounds. He got killed in that Natchez fire. I think that was in 1940. Yeah, about in there.

I remember, I think it was Mrs. Phillips, you know, Babe Phillips, his wife, was going to go to that dance I believe that night. I think a sister of hers was there. I believe she got out. Yeah, something. A few people got out but not many. Not many, not very many got out. Not many was terrible.
Most of them got, most of them strangled. It didn't burn but they strangled. So, one of those things. Yeah. So, I don't, just another thing here. Like this.
